title: CASE-04 — Part-payment mid-delay, rest cycle restarts on the payment date
note: INPUT ONLY, synthetic (golden rule 11): no real parties, Udyam or GSTIN numbers. No outputs are stored here; every number comes from the engine. Synthesised for this repo: the spec's preset table was not available when this file was written, so this case exists to exercise a part-payment under the PAYMENT_DATE_IS_REST_BOUNDARY convention (OQ-3) rather than to mirror a spec row.
why_calculation_date: Deliberate: the delay runs from the appointed day 2026-04-10 (delivery 2026-03-10 plus 30 agreed days) to a calculation date of 2026-08-15, entirely inside the configured 5.50% Bank Rate epoch, so the whole ledger prices at 16.50%. The part-payment falls on 2026-05-15, after the 2026-05-10 rest and before the next one, which is the shape that shows the convention working. Bank Rate epochs before 2026-04-01 are not captured yet (V1 uncaptured, CR-8).

part_payments.reference: synthetic part payment against the invoice
